blueprint_concepts: Multisection of series using roots of unity
english: Let $A=\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{9}(-1)^{k}\binom{28}{3k}$ and $B=\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{8}(-1)^{k}\binom{28}{3k+2}$. Then the value of $\dfrac{A}{B}$ is ______.
hindi: माना $A=\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{9}(-1)^{k}\binom{28}{3k}$ तथा $B=\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{8}(-1)^{k}\binom{28}{3k+2}$ है। तब $\dfrac{A}{B}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Roots of $z^{3}=-1$: $-1,\ \omega=e^{i\pi/3},\ \bar\omega$. For an integer $s$, $\sum_{z^{3}=-1}z^{s}=3(-1)^{s/3}$ if $3\mid s$ and $0$ otherwise
solution_full: The roots of $z^{3}=-1$ are $z=-1$, $\omega=e^{i\pi/3}$ and $\bar\omega=e^{-i\pi/3}$, i.e. $z=-\zeta$ where $\zeta^{3}=1$. For an integer $s$: $\sum_{z^{3}=-1}z^{s}=(-1)^{s}\sum_{\zeta^{3}=1}\zeta^{s}$, which is $3(-1)^{s}=3(-1)^{s/3}$ when $3\mid s$ (as $s$ and $s/3$ have the same parity) and $0$ otherwise.
Hence $\sum_{z^{3}=-1}z^{-j}(1+z)^{28}=\sum_{m}\binom{28}{m}\sum_{z}z^{m-j}=3\sum_{m\equiv j\,(3)}(-1)^{(m-j)/3}\binom{28}{m}$. With $j=0$ this is $3A$; with $j=2$ ($m=3k+2$) it is $3B$.

The root $z=-1$ contributes $0$ since $1+z=0$. For $z=\omega$: $1+\omega=\dfrac{3}{2}+\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}i=\sqrt{3}e^{i\pi/6}$, so $(1+\omega)^{28}=3^{14}e^{i28\pi/6}=3^{14}e^{i14\pi/3}=3^{14}e^{i2\pi/3}$. The root $\bar\omega$ gives the conjugate.
Therefore $\dfrac{A}{B}=-\dfrac{1}{2}=-0.5$ (both values agree with direct computation).
originality_note: New: alternating sums over every third binomial coefficient, filtered by the roots of z^3 = -1 (not of unity), and compared through a ratio (way 5). Closest known: C0 - C2 + C4 - ... = 2^(n/2) cos(n pi/4) using i, and C0 + C3 + C6 + ... using omega. Different because: the alternating sign with step 3 needs the cube roots of -1 and two residue classes are compared.

concept_use.Binomial sums with alternating signs: A and B are alternating sums (-1)^k over the residue classes 0 and 2 modulo 3.
concept_use.Multisection of series using roots of un: The roots of z^3 = -1 filter the residue classes of (1+z)^28 (multisection).

stem_review: Read as a student: both sums have explicit ranges reaching the last admissible index (27 and 26); B is non-zero; answer -0.50 is a negative decimal as planned (exact values checked by code); Hindi mirrors. No change.
key_step: Use the roots of z^3 = -1 (not of unity) to filter the alternating step-3 sums.
justification: A multisection with a twist (cube roots of -1) and polar-form powers; two ideas linked, numerical. Below 2025-P2-Q13 (L4, arg of a sum of powers of -omega) as the method is a known filter once the right roots are chosen.
